basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 43.' and it opens '| Vers. 43. Fecitque ascendere currum. Joseph currum ascendit: quia Christus divinis'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: | Vers. 43. Fecitque ascendere currum. Joseph currum ascendit: quia Christus divinis muneribus decoratus ad coelos rediit. Clamante praecone. Praeco, qui gloriam ejus annuntiabat, est Joannes Baptista, qui primum ejus adventum nuntiavit, sive tuba angelica, quae eum ad judicium venientem praeveniet.
